title.narrative: Integrated multi-sector assistance to support vulnerable communities in drought affected areas in Karsadula and Guradamole Woredas, Liban Zone of Somali Region.

description.narrative: ltpgtltfont color="#4a4a4a"gtltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gtEthiopia has encountered several overlapping humanitarian crises in 2022. This has put the lives and livelihoods of millions of people at risk requiring high and urgent lt/spangthumanitarianltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gt assistance. According to the 2023 Ethiopia Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) more than 20 million people across the country are requiring lt/spangthumanitarianltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gt assistance which includes an estimated 4.6 million internally displaced people (IDPs). Ethiopia is one of the most highly vulnerable countries to climatic shocks and is prone to drought. The failed five rainy seasons has brought severe drought that began in late 2020 which has continued into 2023. This drought has severely impacted pastoralist and agro-pastoralist communities, particularly in the eastern and southern parts of the country, aggravating food insecurity, malnutrition, access to water and a worsening health situation with an increase of disease outbreaks. In response to the lt/spangthumanitarianltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gt crisis arise from the lt/spangtdroughtltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gt, CARE is proposing to respond in lt/spangtLiben Zone of Somali Region in the prioritized areas of lt/fontgtltspan style="color: rgb(74, 74, 74)"gtWASH, Agriculture and Protection. The response will belt/spangtltfont color="#4a4a4a" style="font-size: 14px"gtltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gt an integrated multisectoral interventions. The project will be implemented in partnership with lt/spangtlt/fontgtltspan style="font-size: 11pt color: black"gtAction for the Needy in Ethiopia (ANE) in lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gtKarsadula and Guradamole woredas of Liban Zone, Somali Region. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gtCARE will be implementing interventions in Agriculture and Protection sectors in both woredas while ANE will implement interventions in WASH sector in both woredas.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gtltbrgtlt/pgt
